Subject: Post-call: GenovaX on-prem qualification — environmental & upgrade notes

Alan / Sallie,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and action items from our call regarding the air-gapped on-prem deployment option:

- Air-gap requirement: confirmed — GenovaX requires fully isolated network with no outbound egress to public internet. We discussed using removable media for OS/firmware updates.
- Site environmental needs: power capacity per rack, 3-phase distribution, cooling (CRAC redundancy), and UPS/N+1 requirements listed below.
- Upgrade cadence & offline ops: you prefer quarterly maintenance windows; we outlined a staged offline upgrade approach with signed image media and rollbacks.
- Spares & lead times: you'll confirm spare hardware SKU lead times; we've included recommended spares in the attached spec.

Attachments:
- site-power-plan.pdf (site template for power/Cooling sketches)
- rwd-onprem-hw-specs-2027.xlsx (Redwood hardware & spare SKU recommendations)

Next steps:
1) Ben and Marissa to provide detailed rack-level power and network isolation checklist (today + EOD).
2) Redwood to produce a draft Mutual Action Plan and SOW for survey & deployment (Ben — target 3 business days).
3) Schedule a site survey week of July 5 — please confirm your preferred dates.

If anything above is wrong or missing, flag it and I will update.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Tessa,

Thanks for the concise summary — very helpful. A couple of clarifying questions from our infra team:

- Sustained throughput: we expect ~250 rps for our primary workload with occasional spikes to 700 rps. Can Redwood size the cluster for those peaks or do you recommend a hybrid (dedicated + burst)?
- Backup power: on-site UPS will handle short outages but we need guidance on generator handoff and recommended transfer times.
- Patching windows: our compliance team wants upgrades limited to quarterly windows unless critical. Can the offline upgrade path support signed media and an automated verification step on install?
- Cold media process: if we bring USB/SSD images to site, what are the requirements for image signing, checksums, and physical handoff?

Apologies if some of this was covered — I'm paraphrasing. Sallie will coordinate procurement questions (spares lead time) and I will confirm preferred dates for the July 5 survey after we check internal calendars.

Subject: Re: Post-call: GenovaX on-prem qualification — environmental & upgrade notes

Alan — thanks for the questions, good ones. High level answers and what we'll document for the MAP: 

- Sizing & burst: we can size for your sustained 250 rps with capacity headroom for spikes to ~700 rps using a burst pool on dedicated capacity. If you require absolute isolation for peaks, we recommend a slightly larger baseline cluster rather than relying on cloud-based burst.
- Power & transfer: recommend N+1 UPS at rack level, generator automatic transfer target <= 30s. We'll include recommended PDU specs in the hardware sheet.
- Offline upgrade process: yes — we support signed OS/firmware media. Our offline upgrade playbook uses SHA-256 checksums and signed manifests; updates are applied in staged groups with health checks and automatic rollback on failure.
- Maintenance window: our standard for air-gapped upgrades is a 2–4 hour per-cluster window depending on data size; we’ll size a test window for GenovaX in the MAP.

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP-genovax-v1.docx) that lays out milestones: survey, SOW sign, hardware delivery, bench test, on-site deploy, acceptance. Please review and comment.

Next step: Marissa and I will pull the rack-level checklist and spare SKUs and send the hardware spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow. Also proposing a technical call for July 1 to review the bench test plan — does that work for your team?

Ben Carter
Solutions Lead, Private Deployments | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP-genovax-v1.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-06-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hardware spec and site checklist for GenovaX (attached)

Alan — following Ben's note, attaching the hardware spec and a spares list. Highlights and immediate calls-to-action below.

Attachments:
- rwd-onprem-hw-specs-2027.xlsx (primary spec + rack-level power envelope)
- spares-list-GenovaX.csv (recommended SKUs and suggested quantities)
- offline-upgrade-playbook-v1.2.pdf (process & verification steps)

Site prep checklist (high priority):
- Network isolation: confirm VLAN separation and ensure jump-host access for signed media ingestion.
- HSM/KMS: if you plan to integrate KMS on-prem, we need endpoint and policy details — otherwise we can provide a local HSM recommendation.
- Image signing: Redwood will sign images with our private key. We will provide signing certificates for offline verification.
- Bench testing: recommended 48-hour soak test on bench hardware before any on-site upgrade.
- Rollback plan: keep last-known-good image on removable media and verify checksum before cutover.

Firmware & OS note: some vendor firmware (NIC/BIOS) requires staged upgrades; we strongly recommend completing vendor firmware updates during bench tests. We can coordinate firmware vendor contact info if you need.

Proposed survey: week of July 5 (Mar 5/6/7 slots available on our side) — please confirm 1–2 preferred dates and whether your site security will require a background check for our engineers.

Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: rwd-onprem-hw-specs-2027.xlsx, spares-list-GenovaX.csv, offline-upgrade-playbook-v1.2.pdf
